import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { currentNodes } from "../../../backend/schema/current_nodes";

export const currentNodesCms = customizeTable<typeof currentNodes>("current_nodes", {
    listFields: ["id", "timestamp", "visible", "latitude", "longitude", "tile"],
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "timestamp",
        "visible",
        "latitude",
        "longitude",
        "tile",
        "version",
        "changeset"
    ]
});
